sourceTransport: Existing atlas.quant.market_dataset/1 may supply the source after a future authenticated adapter; this module neither reads transport nor verifies archive bytes.

sourceDomain.U: Complete ordered frozen filter membership; no target selection may rewrite it.
sourceDomain.calendar: Explicit increasing source trading sessions; missing price rows never shorten this calendar.
sourceDomain.ownerKey: Opaque upstream owner identity, never an authentication token; matching this value is not authentication.

priceInput.prices: Positive finite JSON numbers or explicit null; absent rows represent unavailable legs. No filling, rebasing, truncation or external lookup.
priceInput.priceProjectionRoot: SHA256 of canonical {sourceDomainRoot, rows}, sorted by date/symbol; distinct from the upstream dataset manifest root.
priceInput.trustBoundary: The caller must independently authenticate the owner, verify the original source/scope bytes against their roots, and prove this projection came from those bytes. Self-consistent local hashes alone do not do this.

targetScope.T: Explicit ordered pairMap; empty T is allowed and produces no target rows.
targetScope.legs: Exactly two distinct U members, finite nonzero quantities with opposite signs; preserve declared order and direction.
targetScope.duplicates: Reject repeated pairId and repeated unordered member pair, including reversed or rescaled copies.
targetScope.quantityCutoff: Source calendar session strictly before every origin. This is a caller assertion; no OLS, formation or historical provenance verification is performed.
targetScope.quantityFreeze: The same declared signed adjusted-share quantities value every origin, entry and exit; never recompute from later prices.
targetScope.G: Candidate relation graph is absent from this Stage1 explicit-map contract. No automatic graph or matching policy is implied.

memberStates.coverage: Exactly one row for every U member in U order; every incident T pair listed in pairMap order.
memberStates.meaning: Unmatched means not declared in T, not statistically rejected or zero-return. No economic reason is fabricated.

targetMath.G_t: sum_i(abs(q_i * close_i,t)); strictly positive, with CNY basket-value units
targetMath.entry: Source calendar t+1, open prices, identical frozen q
targetMath.exit: Source calendar t+1+horizonSessions, open prices, identical frozen q
targetMath.labelUnit: dimensionless normalized basket-value change, not trading return or profit
targetMath.futureModelRelationOnly: A future model may predict g and reconstruct V=S_t+G_t*g; Stage1 computes no F or predicted V.
targetMath.zeroOrNegativeSpread: Valid when G_t is finite and positive; never divide by S_t.
targetMath.maturity: A complete label is mature only when origin < cutoff and its valuation date < cutoff; the cutoff day itself is excluded.

outputCoverage: Exact T x declared origins, including invalid current values, missing legs and tail dates outside the calendar; U is separately retained in the member ledger.

identity.canonicalization: SHA256 UTF-8 compact JSON, sorted object keys, integral floats encoded as integers; arrays retain declared order except price rows sorted by date/symbol.
identity.sourceDomainRoot: Binds owner, exact dataset/scope refs, complete U, range/calendar and units.
identity.targetScopeRoot: Binds the explicit targetScope including sourceDomainRoot, cutoff, pair IDs and signed quantities.
identity.declarationRoot: Binds every declaration field except declarationRoot itself, including price projection and timing/origins.
identity.resultRoot: Binds every result field except resultRoot itself.

limitBoundary: Finite local input/output shape bounds only. Exceeding any bound rejects the entire request. They neither register a compute profile nor establish pair capacity; all existing guards are unchanged.
